import HartshorneLib.Chapter4CurveDifferentialLattice
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Dimension.FreeAndStrongRankCondition
import Mathlib.RingTheory.Localization.Module

/-!
# A common differential frame on an affine neighborhood

A smooth integral curve has a nonempty affine open on which one rational
differential generates every local regular differential lattice. The generator
is chosen from an affine basis, and is not canonical. This is the geometric
input for finite support of the orders of a rational differential.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory AlgebraicGeometry

namespace Hartshorne

noncomputable section

attribute [local instance] functionFieldOverAlgebra stalkOverAlgebra
  stalkFunctionFieldOver_isScalarTower

variable {k : Type u} [Field k]
variable (X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) [IsIntegral X.left]

omit [IsIntegral X.left] in
/-- Section and stalk ground-field actions commute with taking germs. -/
theorem curveSectionStalkOver_isScalarTower (U : X.left.Opens) (x : U) :
    letI : Algebra k Γ(X.left, U) := (X.left.overAlgebraMap k U).toAlgebra
    letI : Algebra Γ(X.left, U) (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) :=
      X.left.presheaf.algebra_section_stalk x
    IsScalarTower k Γ(X.left, U) (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) := by
  letI : Algebra k Γ(X.left, U) := (X.left.overAlgebraMap k U).toAlgebra
  letI : Algebra Γ(X.left, U) (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) :=
    X.left.presheaf.algebra_section_stalk x
  apply IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq'
  ext r
  change (X.left.presheaf.germ ⊤ x trivial).hom (X.left.overAlgebraMap k ⊤ r) =
    (X.left.presheaf.germ U x x.2).hom (X.left.overAlgebraMap k U r)
  have hres := X.left.presheaf.germ_res_apply (homOfLE (le_top : U ≤ ⊤))
    x x.2 (X.left.overAlgebraMap k ⊤ r)
  rw [X.left.overAlgebraMap_apply_res k (homOfLE (le_top : U ≤ ⊤)).op r] at hres
  exact hres.symm

/-- A chosen rational differential generates every regular differential lattice
on some affine neighborhood of any specified point of a smooth integral curve.
The generator is choice-dependent; only the existence and nonvanishing claims
are invariant. -/
theorem smoothCurve_exists_affine_differentialFrame_at (x₀ : X.left)
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 X.hom] :
    ∃ U : X.left.Opens, IsAffineOpen U ∧ x₀ ∈ U ∧ genericPoint X.left ∈ U ∧
      ∃ η : CurveRationalDifferentials X, η ≠ 0 ∧
        ∀ x ∈ U, ∃ e : X.left.presheaf.stalk x ≃ₗ[X.left.presheaf.stalk x]
          curveRegularDifferentialLattice X x,
          (e 1 : CurveRationalDifferentials X) = η := by
  obtain ⟨U, hU, hx₀U, hsm⟩ :=
    smoothCurve_exists_standardSmooth_affineOpen X x₀
  have hηU : genericPoint X.left ∈ U :=
    ((genericPoint_spec X.left).mem_open_set_iff
      (U := (↑U : Set X.left)) U.isOpen).mpr (by
        simpa using (show (U : Set X.left).Nonempty from ⟨x₀, hx₀U⟩))
  haveI : Nonempty U := ⟨⟨x₀, hx₀U⟩⟩
  letI : Algebra k Γ(X.left, U) := (X.left.overAlgebraMap k U).toAlgebra
  haveI : Algebra.IsStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 k Γ(X.left, U) := hsm.toAlgebra
  haveI : Algebra.IsStandardSmooth k Γ(X.left, U) := hsm.isStandardSmooth.toAlgebra
  haveI : IsScalarTower k Γ(X.left, U) X.left.functionField :=
    curveSectionStalkOver_isScalarTower X U ⟨genericPoint X.left, hηU⟩
  let b : Module.Basis Unit Γ(X.left, U) Ω[Γ(X.left, U)⁄k] :=
    Module.basisUnique Unit (Module.finrank_eq_of_rank_eq
      (Algebra.IsStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension.rank_kaehlerDifferential
        (R := k) (S := Γ(X.left, U)) 1))
  let η : CurveRationalDifferentials X :=
    KaehlerDifferential.map k k Γ(X.left, U) X.left.functionField (b ())
  have hframes : ∀ x ∈ U,
      ∃ e : X.left.presheaf.stalk x ≃ₗ[X.left.presheaf.stalk x]
        curveRegularDifferentialLattice X x,
        (e 1 : CurveRationalDifferentials X) = η := by
    intro x hx
    letI : Algebra Γ(X.left, U) (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) :=
      X.left.presheaf.algebra_section_stalk ⟨x, hx⟩
    haveI : IsScalarTower k Γ(X.left, U) (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) :=
      curveSectionStalkOver_isScalarTower X U ⟨x, hx⟩
    haveI : IsScalarTower Γ(X.left, U) (X.left.presheaf.stalk x)
        X.left.functionField := functionField_isScalarTower X.left U ⟨x, hx⟩
    haveI : IsLocalization.AtPrime (X.left.presheaf.stalk x)
        (hU.primeIdealOf ⟨x, hx⟩).asIdeal := hU.isLocalization_stalk ⟨x, hx⟩
    let S := (hU.primeIdealOf ⟨x, hx⟩).asIdeal.primeCompl
    let f := KaehlerDifferential.map k k Γ(X.left, U) (X.left.presheaf.stalk x)
    haveI : IsLocalizedModule S f :=
      KaehlerDifferential.isLocalizedModule_map k Γ(X.left, U)
        (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) S
    let bx := b.ofIsLocalizedModule (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) S f
    let e₀ := (Module.Basis.singleton Unit (X.left.presheaf.stalk x)).equiv bx
      (Equiv.refl Unit)
    let e := e₀.trans (curveRegularDifferentialLatticeEquiv X x)
    refine ⟨e, ?_⟩
    have he : e₀ 1 = f (b ()) := by
      simpa [e₀, bx] using
        (Module.Basis.singleton Unit (X.left.presheaf.stalk x)).equiv_apply
          () bx (Equiv.refl Unit)
    change KaehlerDifferential.map k k (X.left.presheaf.stalk x)
      X.left.functionField (e₀ 1) = η
    rw [he]
    have hcomp :
        ((KaehlerDifferential.map k k (X.left.presheaf.stalk x)
          X.left.functionField).restrictScalars Γ(X.left, U)).comp f =
        KaehlerDifferential.map k k Γ(X.left, U) X.left.functionField := by
      ext a
      simp [f, IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply Γ(X.left, U)
        (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) X.left.functionField]
    exact LinearMap.congr_fun hcomp (b ())
  refine ⟨U, hU, hx₀U, hηU, η, ?_, hframes⟩
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := hframes x₀ hx₀U
  intro hzero
  have hezero : e 1 = 0 := Subtype.ext (he.trans hzero)
  exact one_ne_zero (e.injective (hezero.trans e.map_zero.symm))

/- The generic-point form retained for downstream users. -/
theorem smoothCurve_exists_affine_differentialFrame
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 X.hom] :
    ∃ U : X.left.Opens, IsAffineOpen U ∧ genericPoint X.left ∈ U ∧
      ∃ η : CurveRationalDifferentials X, η ≠ 0 ∧
        ∀ x ∈ U, ∃ e : X.left.presheaf.stalk x ≃ₗ[X.left.presheaf.stalk x]
          curveRegularDifferentialLattice X x,
          (e 1 : CurveRationalDifferentials X) = η := by
  obtain ⟨U, hU, hηU, -, η, hη, hframes⟩ :=
    smoothCurve_exists_affine_differentialFrame_at X (genericPoint X.left)
  exact ⟨U, hU, hηU, η, hη, hframes⟩

end
end Hartshorne
